research_question: Can one learned factor plus the observable market factor match or exceed the five-learned-factor span across pricing geometries on the original 74 assets?
loading_case: For every model, estimate strict factor self-pricing loadings in 2000-2009 and freeze them for 2010-2019.
primary_contrast: Paired K=1 plus Mkt-RF minus K=5 squared distance on the original combined 74 assets.
interpretation_rule: Market completion is supported if K=1 plus Mkt-RF closes at least 75% of the original K=1 versus K=5 gamma-zero squared-distance gap, has nonpositive seed-mean gaps at both gamma endpoints, and has a nonpositive gamma-zero gap in at least four of five paired seeds. No result promotes the teacher because alpha and prior stability gates remain binding.
boundary: This fixed-factor diagnostic cannot retrain models, select a dimension, alter V015-V017 or access the sealed period.
